subject.title: fix(config): reject unsupported MCP disabled config

question: Should existing MCP configs using the unsupported `disabled` key become validation errors now, with `openclaw doctor --fix` as the required recovery path?
rationale: The patch is technically sound and follows repository architecture, but only maintainers can accept the intentional operator-visible upgrade boundary created by stricter validation.

options.title: Accept migration-backed strictness
options.body: Merge with the tested root and node-host doctor migration and treat strict rejection as the supported canonical-config boundary.

options.title: Delay strict rejection
options.body: Keep this PR open or revise it if maintainers want a longer transition before unsupported persisted keys invalidate configuration.

recommendation.title: Accept migration-backed strictness
recommendation.body: Merge with the tested root and node-host doctor migration and treat strict rejection as the supported canonical-config boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the MCP config/runtime path and recently maintained the exact config and migration area.
